title: Confessions GET advertises ct=112 but returns application/cbor 60
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/confessions.py
Perspective: correctness

get_link_description() sets ct=str(int(SENML_CBOR)) i.e. 112.
render_get, _collection_body, and render_one set
msg.opt.content_format = CBOR (60) and encode the 18.10.7 query map
(count, confessions[], rate_*, storage_*), not a SenML pack.

Spec 18.10.7 and test vector get_confessions_with_metadata expected
content_format 60. Spec 18.10.2 still says GET Content-Format
application/senml+cbor. .well-known/core therefore advertises 112
while the body is application/cbor.

Clients that decode advertised 112 as RFC 8428 SenML+CBOR will
misparse the collection and by-id maps.

Acceptance: advertised ct MUST match the GET body (60 per 18.10.7),
or GET must actually emit SenML+CBOR if 112 remains the contract.
